steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Configure the core application metadata including app name and unique package namespace.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Establish proper Android SDK dependencies, compiler configurations, build properties, and Java 8 target version compatible with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish custom permissions, configure application hardware acceleration, define launcher activity, and enforce material styling theme.

steps.title: Create Main Activity UI Layout
steps.description: Define layout structure combining custom hardware-accelerated Canvas GameView and absolute retro overlay elements for menu, levels, and status readouts.

steps.title: Implement Brick, Ball, and Power-Up Data Models
steps.description: Write Java 8 classes within GameView to manage coordinate geometry, bounding boxes, state machines, and collision vectors of physical objects.

steps.title: Implement Retro Audio Synth Engine
steps.description: Implement hardware-level synthesized beep sounds and feedback using android.media.ToneGenerator to simulate authentic 8-bit arcade audio chips.

steps.title: Create Android Game Loop Engine
steps.description: Program precise frame-rate loop handling physics steps, collision resolution, dynamic score compilation, and draw-calls using standard handler cycles.

steps.title: Configure SharedPreferences High Score Saver
steps.description: Code persistent high score mechanisms using standard storage within standard lifecycle handlers to retain historic top arcade scores.

steps.title: Connect Custom UI Overlays and Handlers
steps.description: Wire layout buttons to control game states including restart, play, toggle sound settings, level triggers, and update HUD metrics dynamically.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Configurations and Namespaces
steps.description: Run strict syntax and namespace validation matching the specific configuration for successful error-free Gradle execution.

steps.title: Building Retro Brick Breaker
steps.description: Final compilation execution compiling clean Java 8 byte-code to direct debug executable package format.
